title: LeaseEvent
description: The payload of every lease and attempt transition event (docs/design/m0/05): <transition>/v1, e.g. lease.granted/v1 or attempt.sealed/v1. Each carries the record(s) as they are after the transition, so a projection is the latest record and a rebuild is a fold. internal/lease checks, in the writer transaction, that every record is exactly its state machine's result from the current one; the event's subject is the lease (lease.*) or the attempt (attempt.*). attempt.started and attempt.superseded also change the lease under the attempt's subject, so commands expect a record's projection revision (not its subject's last seq) for every record they act on. attempt.superseded is atomic: one event carries the retired attempt, its successor (with the next token) and the lease the successor runs under (05: supersession and the replacement's token in one transaction).

reason.description: Why: required for lease.revoked and lease.restore_failed (05), null otherwise. Attempt stop and loss reasons live in the attempt record.

lease.description: The lease after a lease transition, or after attempt.started (granted → active).

attempt.description: The attempt after an attempt transition (for attempt.superseded, the retired one).

successor.description: attempt.superseded only: the replacement attempt, started with the next token.
